name: real-time-desktop-agent
description: Realtime Windows desktop complement for AI agents with capture, vision, mouse, keyboard, UIA, and safe dry-run actions.

interface.shortDescription: Realtime desktop capture and safe automation tools for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Expose RTDA as a local MCP-backed plugin for ChatGPT and Codex. The plugin provides monitor discovery, capture diagnostics, UI Automation inspection, planning, action classification, and dry-run action execution.
defaultPrompt: Use Real-Time Desktop Agent to list available monitors.
Use Real-Time Desktop Agent to run a capture diagnostic.
Use Real-Time Desktop Agent to inspect UIA elements for the active desktop workflow.
